questions.question: Full Matrix (3.13 only) is red because of test_a_none_read_is_refused_on_every_write_route, added in #1148 (BUG-328/BK-441), not because of #1154. The scheduled run on the commit before #1154 failed the same way. In the async cell, the kernel refuses the None chunk and abandons the caller's async generator mid-iteration (_marked in _kernel/_async/_io.py never acloses it). It's finalized later on the shared test loop, and pytest blames whichever test runs next. No spec says who closes a caller's content iterator. How should I fix it?

options.label: Test fix + backlog item (Recommended)
options.description: The test owns the generator, so it acloses it after the raise (a few lines in test_kernel.py). File a BK item asking whether the kernel should aclose caller iterators it abandons. Branch + push, no behavior change, CI green fast.

options.label: Library closes the iterator
options.description: _marked acloses the caller's iterator when it refuses a chunk or the write fails. A real behavior change: needs a spec clause (ASYNC-*/BE-030), a conformance test, CHANGELOG and a trace. Bigger PR, slower to green.

options.label: Test fix only
options.description: Just make the test close its generator. No backlog item, so the open product question isn't recorded anywhere.
